GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 168 (17 Dec 45) ESS/AC
(SCAPIN - 453)
APO 500
17 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Applications for Redemption of Serial Bonds
1. References are CLO, LO 41 and 42 dated 6 December 1945, subject: ’’Dissolution of Holding Companies," which request permission to redeem serial debentures listed in applications attached thereto.
2. Your attention is directed to paragraph 3c (1) (2), of memorandum this headquarters, AG 004 (8 Dec 45) ESS/AC, dated 8 December, Subject: "Establishment of a Schedule of Restricted Concerns," which authorized the payment of such debentures.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
